# Native Agent metadata conformance

`owner-ledger-conformance.json` was generated by the actual public
`AgentConsumptionLedger` from Runtime source revision
`8ef88c13b9c55fd78b6314b05862675adcd4379f`, using the shared
`components/policy-runtime/contracts/fixtures/agent-session-v1.json`
acquisitions. It records accepted acknowledgements and rejected report cases,
without introducing a second numerical implementation.

The cases cover a neutral Current capture with null publication, a legitimate
non-adjacent revisit with a newer native revision, rejected duplicate advances,
valid incremental scope expansion and a neutral repeat, rejected reused
consumption IDs, and valid full-reference null persistent content. Tests bind
the recorded witness metadata to the existing typed Evidence path. The fixture
does not contain real game/Human data or prove native/content coherence or
numerical Model memory.
